_comment: Machine-readable registry for the leitwörter convention (see LEITWORTER.md). The `guards` block is enforced by scripts/check_leitworter.py and the CI workflow: must_contain entries are deletion tripwires (the leitwort must still be present), must_not_contain entries are drift tripwires (an old generic phrasing must not return). The `canon` block is the cross-skill vocabulary, used by skill-expert and for warn-only drift hints. Matching is case-insensitive substring.
